title: Billing and Coding: Surgical Management of Morbid Obesity

codes.1: The following CPT codes associated with the services outlined in this Billing and Coding Article will not have diagnosis code limitations applied at this time: 43771, 43772, 43773, 43774, and 43848. Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book.

covered.1: Primary and Secondary Diagnoses Coverage for selected bariatric surgery procedures on patients who meet national and local coverage criteria set forth in the LCD requires reporting three appropriate diagnoses. Report the primary diagnosis as one of the following ICD-10-CM codes in Group 1: E66.01 (morbid obesity); or E66.812 (obesity, class 2); or E66.813 (obesity, class 3). Report a secondary diagnosis for body mass index (BMI) from ICD-10-CM codes Group 1 and a tertiary diagnosis from ICD-10-CM codes Group 2. It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted.
